editorial.blurb: Gibson's is a classic Chicago steakhouse delivering exceptional prime steaks and seafood in a lively, welcoming atmosphere with consistently attentive service.
editorial.insiderTip: Book in advance—the restaurant fills up quickly—and request outdoor seating if you prefer a quieter experience than the bustling main dining room during peak hours.

topDishes.note: server-recommended prime steak that never steers guests wrong
expertly prepared prime cut consistently praised by diners
